ios.desc:
Air Alarm Ukraine helps you stay informed about air alerts, curfew times, and other important safety information across Ukraine.
Choose the regions you want to monitor and receive timely notifications about alerts and important events.

Key features:
• Air alert notifications for selected regions
• Critical Alerts for important notifications
• Monitor one or multiple regions across Ukraine
• Find nearby shelters on the map
• Curfew information with notifications when curfew starts and ends
• Nationwide Minute of Silence reminders
• Upload and use your own custom notification sounds
• Choose different sounds for different types of alerts
• Simple and intuitive interface
• Fast and stable performance for everyday use  

Stay informed about the regions that matter to you.

Air Alarm Ukraine is designed as a convenient additional source of safety information, with quick access to alerts, shelters, curfew information, and important notifications in one place.

Important: Air Alarm Ukraine is an independent informational app and is not an official government emergency alert system. Do not rely solely on the app for safety-critical decisions. Always follow official alerts, sirens, and instructions from Ukrainian authorities.
